metric: RGB SSIM, Gaussian 11x11 sigma 1.5, population covariance
normalization: No alignment, color correction, mask, region weighting or content removal. Original identical-size whole frames. Only 5px mathematical window border omitted.
limitations: Same scene/time/view comparison, not cross-scene similarity or device FPS evidence. Joystick intentionally differs from approved two-arrow mockup. Environment is derived from the approved art; dynamic sprites/UI are implemented separately.
